string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_STUN_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. You cannot move because of a strong shock. You cannot remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.body: A mental Altered State. You cannot move as your mind wanders. You can remove this Altered State by using magic.

string.name: STR_ITEM_SKILL_PROC_BLEED_DESC
string.body: A physical Altered State. Your HP decreases gradually because you are severely injured. You can remove this Altered State by using magic or potion.

string.name: STR_FOOD_D_3C_FLYINGEYE_29_AE_DESC
string.body: Transforms you into an Oculazen for 10 minutes. You can detect targets in basic stealth while transformed.

string.name: STR_FOOD_D_MAHISHADRAKYD_31_AN_DESC
string.body: Transforms you into a Malek Drakie for 60 minutes.

string.name: STR_FOOD_D_AGRINTICED_36_AN_DESC
string.body: Transforms you into a Frozen Agrint for 60 minutes. You recover health and mana faster while transformed.

string.name: STR_EVENT_COUPON_CUSTOMIZE_01_DESC
string.body: You can change your face and body shape. You can change your appearance by going to the Daeva of Appearance in the Angelic Frippery.

string.name: STR_EVENT_COUPON_SEX_EXCHANGE_01_DESC
string.body: You can change your gender as well as your face and body shape. Elyos can change gender by going to Euripides in a tavern in the Outer Dock, and Asmodians can visit Jotunmodr in the back alleys of the Pandaemonium Plaza to change their gender.

string.name: STR_KEY_LF2A_LAB_01_DESC
string.body: An old key that Queen Arachne swallowed. It probably unlocks a chest kept somewhere inside the laboratory.

string.name: STR_KEY_LF2A_LAB_02_DESC
string.body: A key with a flame-shaped emblem for the last door in the Ice Corridor.

string.name: STR_KEY_LF2A_LAB_03_DESC

string.body: A key with a wind-shaped emblem for the right door of the Research Center.

string.name: STR_KEY_LF2A_LAB_06_DESC

string.name: STR_KEY_LF2A_LAB_07_DESC
string.body: A key with an emblem for the Four Spirits for the Secret Research Centre Vault.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_01_DESC
string.body: A key with an ornate emblem for the right corridor on the second floor.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_02_DESC
string.body: A key with a carved emblem for the left corridor on the second floor.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_03_DESC
string.body: A key with a spear-and-shield emblem for the locked door in the reception room before Karemiwen's Bedroom.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_04A_DESC
string.body: This key opens The Great Hall. Its size and shape indicate that it is a key for a huge, wooden door.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_04B_DESC
string.body: This key opens the Lannok Treasury. Its size and thickness indicate that it is a key for a heavy door with an iron latch.

string.name: STR_KEY_DF2A_ADMA_04C_DESC
string.body: This key opens the Servants Quarters. Its small size indicate that it is a key of minor importance.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_01_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect that adds a 50%% chance of inflicting fire damage with the main hand and a 0%% chance with the off hand. \nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_02_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect that adds a 0%% chance of inflicting water damage with the main hand and a 50%% chance with the off hand. \nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_03_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect that adds a 50%% chance of inflicting earth damage with the main hand and a 20%% chance with the off hand. \nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_04_DESC
string.body: Imbues a weapon with an effect that adds a 20%% chance of inflicting wind damage with the main hand and a 50%% chance with the off hand. \nActivate the Godstone by double-clicking (right-click) and then select the item you want to enhance.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_01_DESC_PROC
string.body: There is a 50% chance to inflict fire damage with the main hand, and a 0% chance with the off hand.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_02_DESC_PROC
string.body: There is a 0% chance to inflict water damage with the main hand, and a 50% chance with the off hand.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_03_DESC_PROC
string.body: There is a 50% chance to inflict earth damage with the main hand, and a 20% chance with the off hand.

string.name: STR_TEST_MATTER_PROC_04_DESC_PROC
string.body: There is a 20% chance to inflict wind damage with the main hand, and a 50% chance with the off hand.

string.body: Metal ore transformed after absorbing the powerful magic of the Balaur, it is also called as the Ore of Death. Normally not used due to its high toxicity, but skilled Daevas have been known to use DP to remove the toxin.

string.name: STR_EVENT_F_KISK_LIGHT_PRIVATE_SMALL_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk for resurrection. The summoned Kisk will remain summoned for 2 hours and has a cool-down time of 12 hours.\nOnly the summoner can use the Kisk.

string.body: Item to test the class limit\nUse only LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1 in the test\nThe test should work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_02DESC
string.body:
Item to test the raise limit
Use only Gchief_Light in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_03DESC
string.body:
Item to test the simultaneous raise limit for a single class
Use Gchief_Light and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1 in the test 
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_04DESC
string.body:
Item to test the simultaneous raise limit for 4 multiple classes
Use Gchief_Light, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_2, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_3, and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_4 in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1~4
The test should work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_05DESC
string.body:
Item to test the simultaneous raise limit for 5 multiple classes
Use Gchief_Light, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_2, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_3, LF4_2011_Boss_Li_4, and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_5 in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should not work. You can apply up to 4 classes. Actually it doesn't matter whether it works or not... -_-

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_06DESC
string.body:
Item to test the simultaneous raise limit for a single class
Use Gchief_Dark and LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1 in the test
Possible to test by summoning LF4_2011_Boss_Li_1
The test should not work.

string.name: STR_ITEM_TEST_AVATAR_BUFF_07DESC

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_50A_DESC
string.body: Superb Wings created by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. The wings' performance is outstanding. They were crafted by Haroshunerk, an Expert from the Tigraki Studio.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_50A_DESC
string.body: Superb Wings of outstanding performance that the 9th Pandaemonium Research Centre ordered Naorunerk, the top apprentice of Dalushunerk, to create.

string.name: STR_KEY_LF4_TEMPLE01_01_DESC
string.body: One of the keys of the Path of Reflection. It is engraved with a pen symbol. It may be the key to the Silent Chapel.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_LIMIT_01
string.body: When you have exceeded the limit for the number of items you can buy, you must wait for a certain period of time before you can buy again.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_SALE_LIMIT_01
string.body: Items that have been sold out are restocked after a certain period of time has passed.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_LIMIT_02
string.body: You can't buy more than the allocated amount without reentering Taloc.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_01
string.body: This is a limited sale item with a daily purchase limit, and can only be purchased again 24 hours after the time of last purchase. Sold-out items will be restocked at certain hours.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_L_MEDAL_POCKET_60A_DESC
string.body: You can obtain Mithril coins by opening the chest, but there is no knowing how many it may hold inside.

string.name: STR_WRAP_QUEST_D_MEDAL_POCKET_60A_DESC
string.body: You can obtain Mithril coins by opening the chest, but there is no knowing how many it may hold inside.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_50B_DESC
string.body: Major Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted using a new method by an Expert from the Tigraki Studio, Haroshunerk, these are wings of outstanding quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_50B_DESC
string.body: Major Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Centre with the skills of Naorunerk, the top apprentice of Daloshunerk. These are wings of outstanding quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted by Naorunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_40B_DESC
string.body: Greater Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted by an Expert from the Tigraki Studio, Daloshunerk, these are wings of superb quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_40B_DESC
string.body: Greater Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Centre with the skills of Naorunerk, the top apprentice of Daloshunerk. These are wings of superb quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted by Naorunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_30B_DESC
string.body: Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. The wings' performance is passable, as they were crafted by Chantinerk, an apprentice of Daloshunerk.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_30B_DESC
string.body: Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Center, which remodeled the Midnight Wings for mass production.

string.name: STR_WING_LIGHT_30C_DESC
string.body: Wings made by 'Kaisinel's Wings', an organization under the guidance of the Empyrean Lord Kaisinel. Crafted by Chantinerk, an apprentice of Daloshunerk, these are wings of decent quality where only one or two pairs are produced from every hundred crafted.

string.name: STR_WING_DARK_30C_DESC
string.body: Wings made by the 9th Pandaemonium Research Center, which remodeled the Midnight Wings for use by commander-rank officers.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_03
string.body: This is a limited sale item with a daily purchase limit, and can only be purchased again 24 hours after the time of last purchase. Sold-out items will be restocked at certain hours.

string.name: STR_SALE_EXPLAIN_BUY_SALE_LIMIT_04
string.body: Items that have been sold out are restocked at 6 and 12 o'clock daily. Each person can buy up to the limited number for each item.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE59_3_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Alabaster Wing> title.\nThis title increases your physical attack by 2 points and magic boosting power by 10 points, and is usable for 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE60_7_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Alabaster Eye> title.\nThis title increases your physical attack by 3 points and magic boosting power by 17 points, and is usable for 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE61_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Alabaster Hand> title.\nThis title increases your physical attack by 3 points, magic boosting power by 17 points, movement speed by 4%%, and flight speed by 3%%.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE62_3_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Radiant Fist>.\nIf you bear this title, your physical and magical attack strength will increase by 1%% in PvP.\nIts effect lasts 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE63_3_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Radiant Shield>.\nIf you bear this title, your physical and magical defence will increase by 1%% in PvP.\nIts effect lasts 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE64_7_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Radiant Blade>.\nIf you bear this title, your physical and magical attack strength will increase by 2%% in PvP.\nIts effect lasts 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE65_7_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Radiant Shroud>.\nIf you bear this title, your physical and magical defence will increase by 2%% in PvP.\nIts effect lasts 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE66_DESC
string.body: Use it to buy the title <Seeker>.\nIf you bear this title, both your physical and magical attack strength and your physical and magical defence will increase by 2%% in PvP.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE67_10_DESC
string.body: Bestows the <Tracker> title.\nThis title increases your attack speed and casting speed by 1%%, and is usable for 3 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE68_20_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE69_DESC

string.name: STR_ITEM_DARK_TITLE60_7_DESC

string.name: STR_SHULACK_POTION_01_DESC
string.body: A metal refiner made using a secret Shulack technique. You can use it in the furnace in Debilkarim's Forge, but it'll be wasted if you don't have all the materials you need.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LIGHT_TITLE58_DESC

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_LIGHT_40_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Marvellous Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-40 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_LIGHT_50_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Recondite Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 2 hours, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-50 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_LIGHT_60_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Heavenly Profound Charm is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-60 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_DARK_40_DESC
string.body: You gain 10%% additional XP from hunting, gathering, and crafting while the Blue Jotun Amulet is active.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour, and after it expires you cannot use it again for 10 hours. Players of level 1-40 can use this charm.

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_DARK_50_DESC

string.name: STR_QUEST_XPBOOST_DARK_60_DESC
